46 /**
47 * @ingroup arrays_views
48 * @brief A generic multi-dimensional array.
49 *
50 * @details Together with nda::basic_array_view, this class forms the backbone of the **nda** library. It is templated
51 * with the following parameters:
52 *
53 * - `ValueType`: This is the type of the elements stored in the array. Most of the time, this will be a scalar type
54 * like an `int`, `double` or `std::complex<double>`, but it can also be a more complex type like a custom class or a
55 * another nda::basic_array.
56 * - `Rank`: Integer specifying the number of dimensions of the array. This is a compile-time constant.
57 * - `LayoutPolicy`: The layout policy specifies how the array views the memory it uses and how it accesses its
58 * elements. It provides a mapping from multi-dimensional to linear indices and vice versa (see @ref layout_pols).
59 * - `Algebra`: The algebra specifies how an array behaves when it is used in an expression. Possible values are 'A'
60 * (array), 'M' (matrix) and 'V' (vector) (see nda::get_algebra).
61 * - `ContainerPolicy`: The container policy specifies how and where the data is stored. It is responsible for
62 * allocating/deallocating the memory (see @ref mem_handles).
63 *
64 * In contrast to views (see nda::basic_array_view), regular arrays own the memory they use for data storage.
65 *
66 * @include doc_basic_array.cpp
67 *
68 * Output:
69 *
70 * ```
71 *
72 * [[1,1]
73 * [1,1]
74 * [1,1]]
75 *
76 * [[42,42]
77 * [1,1]
78 * [1,1]]
79 * ```
80 *
81 * Arrays and views share a lot of the same operations and functionalities. To turn a view into a regular array, use
82 * nda::make_regular.
83 *
84 * @tparam ValueType Type stored in the array.
85 * @tparam Rank Number of dimensions of the array.
86 * @tparam LayoutPolicy Policy determining the memory layout.
87 * @tparam Algebra Algebra of the array.
88 * @tparam ContainerPolicy Policy determining how and where the data is stored.
89 */
90 template <typename ValueType, int Rank, typename LayoutPolicy, char Algebra, typename ContainerPolicy>
91 class basic_array {
92 // Compile-time checks.
93 static_assert(!std::is_const_v<ValueType>, "Error in nda::basic_array: ValueType cannot be const");
94 static_assert((Algebra != 'N'), "Internal error in nda::basic_array: Algebra 'N' not supported");
95 static_assert((Algebra != 'M') or (Rank == 2), "Internal error in nda::basic_array: Algebra 'M' requires a rank 2 array");
96 static_assert((Algebra != 'V') or (Rank == 1), "Internal error in nda::basic_array: Algebra 'V' requires a rank 1 array");
97
98 public:
99 /// Type of the values in the array (can not be const).
100 using value_type = ValueType;
101
102 /// Type of the memory layout policy (see @ref layout_pols).
103 using layout_policy_t = LayoutPolicy;
104
105 /// Type of the memory layout (an nda::idx_map).
106 using layout_t = typename LayoutPolicy::template mapping<Rank>;
107
108 /// Type of the container policy (see @ref mem_pols).
109 using container_policy_t = ContainerPolicy;
110
111 /// Type of the memory handle (see @ref mem_handles).
112 using storage_t = typename ContainerPolicy::template handle<ValueType>;
113
114 /// The associated regular type.
115 using regular_type = basic_array;
116
117 /// Number of dimensions of the array.
118 static constexpr int rank = Rank;
119
120 // Compile-time check.
121 static_assert(has_contiguous(layout_t::layout_prop), "Error in nda::basic_array: Memory layout has to be contiguous");
122
123 private:
124 // Type of the array itself.
125 using self_t = basic_array;
126
127 // Type of the accessor policy for views (no no_alias_accessor).
128 using AccessorPolicy = default_accessor;
129
130 // Type of the owning policy for views.
131 using OwningPolicy = borrowed<storage_t::address_space>;
132
133 // Constexpr variable that is true if the value_type is const (never for basic_array).

135
136 // Constexpr variable that is true if the array is a view (never for basic_array).
137 static constexpr bool is_view = false;

139 // Memory layout of the array, i.e. the nda::idx_map.

142 // Memory handle of the array.

154 13 auto as_array_view() { return basic_array_view<ValueType, Rank, LayoutPolicy, 'A', AccessorPolicy, OwningPolicy>{*this}; };
